digest.component_or_area: mutation confirmations and CLI reference documentation

Maintain a durable, drift-gated verb inventory table (MUTATION_VERBS in gen_cli_reference.py) classifying all mutation verbs as no-op-capable or always-writes, with a CI gate that fails when an unclassified verb is added.

Record the per-verb old→new confirmation-line mapping table in generated docs/cli-reference.md as golden data, sourced from curated rows in scripts/gen_cli_reference.py and validated against the pre-merge commit 42cd70b889^.
